name: 氛围SunkenLament
lyrics: [纯音乐]

name: Minimal氛围荒废Harbor
lyrics:
[纯音乐]


[主歌1]

穿过 the mist and 消逝 光芒,
A harbor sleeps in endless 夜,
No lanterns glow upon the pier,
Just whispers of what once was here.

[副歌]

Silent waves beneath the moon,
A lullaby for ships that soon,
Will 漂泊 to 沉睡 like all the rest,
In this harbour of quiet rest.

[主歌2]

The lighthouse stands but casts no beam,
A guardian of a forgotten dream,
Its 光芒 extinguished long ago,
Yet still it watches, still it knows.

[副歌]

Silent waves beneath the moon,
A lullaby for ships that soon,
Will 漂泊 to 沉睡 like all the rest,
In this harbour of quiet rest.

name: 氛围SilentDepths
lyrics:
[主歌1]

The 潮汐 pulls back, the streets are still
No footprints mark the passing chill
In harbors deep where 寂静 降临
The moon hangs low behind the 城墙

[副歌]

Silent depths beneath the skin
Where broken tides begin again
We 漂泊 alone 穿过 empty space
And find the 光芒 in hollowing

[主歌2]

The ocean hums a low monotone
A distant star, a broken stone
What whispers 穿过 the empty air
Are echoes only 夜 can share

[副歌]

Silent depths beneath the skin
Where broken tides begin again
We 漂泊 alone 穿过 empty space
And find the 光芒 in hollowing

[桥段]

And in the hush 之间 each wave
We sink beneath what we can't save
But in the depth, the current turns
And somewhere distant, something burns

[副歌]

Silent depths beneath the skin
Where broken tides begin again
We 漂泊 alone 穿过 empty space
And find the 光芒 in hollowing

name: 氛围FathomlessTide
lyrics:
[主歌1]

Beneath the surface deep and wide,
where 寂静 folds like ocean 潮汐,
I 漂泊 穿过 corridors of thought,
where faded memories are brought.

[副歌]

Fathomless 潮汐, it pulls me in,
穿过 corridors where 光芒 grows thin,
the weight of worlds I cannot hold,
still stories left for those untold.

[主歌2]

The current carries what remains,
of fragments lost in endless trains,
穿过 hollow halls I make my way,
to find the end of yesterday.

[副歌]

Fathomless 潮汐, it pulls me in,
穿过 corridors where 光芒 grows thin,
the weight of worlds I cannot hold,
still stories left for those untold.

[尾声]

Fathomless 潮汐

name: 梦幻Cosmic漂流
lyrics:
[主歌1]

星辰 are falling 穿过 the 夜
Silent rivers guide the 光芒
In the hollow of the 天空
Where the wandering souls cry

[副歌]

Dreaming in the cosmic sea
漂浮 weightlessly
穿过 the 裂缝 of 宇宙
We were never meant to be found

[主歌2]

Moonlit shadows 漂泊 apart
Echoes fade from every heart
In the 寂静 deep below
All the 银色 rivers flow

[副歌]

Dreaming in the cosmic sea
漂浮 weightlessly
穿过 the 裂缝 of 宇宙
We were never meant to be found

name: 空灵Fadinginto黎明
lyrics:
[主歌1]

Fog drapes the sleeping city streets,
星辰 fade where 寂静 相遇,
A broken world beneath the moon,
Waiting for the 光芒 to bloom.

[副歌]

消逝 into 黎明, the dream's 边缘 line,
之间 the dark and the first sign,
Whispers carry 穿过 the haze,
As 夜 消融 in pale gold rays.

[主歌2]

Ghosts of 星辰 still cling to 天空,
The soul drifts where worlds collide,
On the border of 沉睡 and wake,
A breath of hope the 寂静 took.

[副歌]

消逝 into 黎明, the dream's 边缘 line,
之间 the dark and the first sign,
Whispers carry 穿过 the haze,
As 夜 消融 in pale gold rays.

[桥段]

Then 光芒 breaks 穿过 the 裂缝 of dream,
A warmth that makes the 暗影 gleam.

[副歌]

消逝 into 黎明, the dream's 边缘 line,
之间 the dark and the first sign,
Whispers carry 穿过 the haze,
As 黎明 becomes the final phrase.

name: 梦幻低语Before黎明
lyrics:
[主歌1]

There's a 寂静 at the 边缘 of 夜
When the world forgets to breathe
I'm holding on to something slipping away
Like a thought I can't retrieve

[副歌]

Whispers before 黎明
secrets no one knows
The 天空 is turning gold
But I'm still holding onto ghosts

[主歌2]

Every star is 消逝 into 湛蓝
Every 暗影 starts to fade
I can almost see the morning coming 穿过
But I'm not quite ready to be saved

[副歌]

Whispers before 黎明
The 光芒 begins to grow
The 夜 releases me
But I'm still here, not quite letting go

name: 梦幻低语BeforeBreaking
lyrics:
🎤 Whispers Before the 崩裂 — Instrumental Track

[Lyrics — wordless vocal意象, no dialogue, purely atmospheric]

This track is instrumental. The "lyrics" exist as emotional layers:

Verse 1 — 寂静
轻柔 breath, ambient space, held.

Verse 2 — the hum
A distant wordless vocal, just vowel sounds, no words.
(Hums in Cm: E♭ — D — C — B♭)

Chorus — the swell
Pad swells upward, filtered, building.
Then release — returning to 寂静

Bridge — the shimmer
High harmonics appear, glass-like, 消逝

Final fade — 寂静 again.

[Total lyrics: Instrumental / Wordless / Emotional atmosphere only]

name: 空灵低语之间Stars
lyrics:
[主歌1]

之间 the 裂缝 in endless 夜,
A 低语 rides on fractured 光芒,
The 星辰 breathe slow, the 寂静 calls,
A dreaming world behind these 城墙

[副歌]

Whispers 之间 星辰 we hear,
In twilight depths, so 寒冷, so clear,
We float 穿过 spaces none can name,
And find ourselves without a frame.

[主歌2]

The mist hangs low on dreaming shores,
No footstep marks what dream restores,
Behind the veil of 沉睡 we 漂泊,
Where 消逝 光芒 and hope feels shift.

[副歌]

Whispers 之间 星辰 we hear,
In twilight depths, so 寒冷, so clear,
We float 穿过 spaces none can name,
And find ourselves without a frame.

name: 空灵低语BeforeHorizon
lyrics:
[主歌1]

The world holds its breath tonight,
星辰 bleed into the sea of 天空
I walk where shadows meet the 光芒,
A silent pilgrim passing by.

[副歌]

Whispers before the horizon calls,
穿过 the haze I hear your name.
Before the 黎明 重写 it all,
I'll keep this moment, keep this flame.

[主歌2]

Fog rolls across the sleeping fields,
A 银色 curtain, thin and white.
Each heartbeat a tomorrow yields,
Each 寂静 tastes like 消逝 光芒

[副歌]

Whispers before the horizon calls,
穿过 the haze I hear your name.
Before the 黎明 重写 it all,
I'll keep this moment, keep this flame.

[桥段]

And when the first gold 裂缝 the 边缘 of 夜,
I won't look back — I'll step into the 明亮

[尾声]

Whispers before the horizon...

name: 明快清晨OverQuiet湖

[主歌1]

The morning 光芒 drifts 轻柔 and slow

Morning over the quiet lake

[主歌2]

Birds call softly 穿过 the haze
Sunrise burns in amber phase
No rush to move, no need to chase
Just stillness where the 光芒 finds place

[副歌]

Morning over the quiet lake
Every breath a promise made
黎明 is 崩裂, hearts align

name: 明快金色Meridian
lyrics:
[主歌1]

The world was still in shadows grey
When you reminded me to stay
One small step 穿过 the open door
A new horizon to explore

[副歌]

We rise before the 光芒 breaks 穿过

Coffee steam and morning birds

name: 原声清晨绽放
lyrics:
[主歌1]

Sunlight spills across the floor,

lyrics:
[主歌1]
